items.name: Audio
items.desc: Audio on or off. Browsers need one click before they play sound.
Window size, percent of the default. Drag any edge or corner to resize; double click the wood to go back to 100%.

items.name: Loop
items.desc: Repeats the playback again and again.

items.name: Play
items.desc: Plays from the cursor, or the start of the selection. Pressed again while playing: stops. Change this in Settings.

items.name: Stop
items.desc: Stops playing and recording.

items.name: Record
items.desc: Records what comes in from the input. Where it starts is set by the buttons next to it.

items.name: Now
items.desc: Recording starts the moment you press Record. Key 1.

items.name: On input
items.desc: Press Record to arm. Recording starts when the incoming sound passes the threshold; the pre-roll is included. Key 2.

items.name: Count-in
items.desc: Press Record, hear the click for the chosen number of bars (4/4), and recording starts on the next downbeat. Key 3.

items.name: Append
items.desc: What a new recording does: replace the sound, append at the end, punch over the selection or insert at the cursor. Click to change.

items.name: Threshold
items.desc: Level that starts a recording when Start is on Threshold.

items.name: Tempo
items.desc: Tempo of the click for the count-in and for recording with the click on. 4/4.

items.name: Pre-roll
items.desc: How much sound from before the start is included in the recording.

items.name: Gain
items.desc: Makes the selection louder or quieter by a fixed amount.

items.name: Normalize
items.desc: Sets the level of the selection to a target. Never pushes the peak above 0 dBFS.

items.name: Fade in
items.desc: Starts silent and rises to full level across the selection.

items.name: Fade out
items.desc: Falls from full level to silence across the selection.

items.name: Reverse
items.desc: Plays the selection backwards.

items.name: Invert polarity
items.desc: Flips the wave upside down. Sounds the same alone, cancels against the original.

items.name: Remove DC offset
items.desc: Centres the wave on zero. Removes a constant push that wastes headroom.

items.name: Silence
items.desc: Replaces the selection with silence, same length.

items.name: Trim silence
items.desc: Cuts quiet parts off the start and end.

items.name: Make mono
items.desc: Turns the selection into one channel on both sides.

items.name: Balance
items.desc: Moves the stereo image left or right. The quieter side goes down, the other stays.

items.name: Pitch and speed
items.desc: Plays the selection faster or slower. Pitch and length change together, like tape.

items.name: Make loop
items.desc: Blends the end into the start so the selection repeats without a click. Becomes a little shorter.

items.name: Bitcrusher
items.desc: Lo-fi: fewer bits and a lower sample rate.

items.name: Drive
items.desc: Three analog style stages, the same as PurrOne: Drive, Transistor and Fuzz. Level matched.

items.name: EQ
items.desc: Low shelf at 120 Hz, a bell and a high shelf at 8 kHz.

items.name: Filter
items.desc: Low pass, high pass or band pass.

items.name: Delay
items.desc: Echoes. The tail can be added after the selection so it rings out.

items.name: Chorus
items.desc: Thickens by mixing in slightly detuned copies.

items.name: Phaser
items.desc: Sweeping notches that move up and down.

items.name: Reverb
items.desc: A room around the sound. The tail can be added so it rings out.

items.name: Compressor
items.desc: Turns down what is above the threshold.

items.name: Limiter
items.desc: Stops peaks from going above the ceiling. Looks ahead, so nothing gets through.

items.name: Noise gate
items.desc: Silences what is below the threshold.

items.name: New empty sound
items.desc: Starts with an empty sound. Undo brings the old one back.

items.name: Open file
items.desc: Opens an audio file. You can also drop a file on the display.

items.name: Save as WAV
items.desc: Saves the sound as a WAV file. In this web mockup the browser may block the download.

items.name: Undo
items.desc: Nothing to undo.

items.name: Redo
items.desc: Nothing to redo. Ctrl+Shift+Z repeats the last operation.

items.name: History
items.desc: Every step of this sound, with its own undo that is separate from the host. Click to jump back to any step.

items.name: Cut
items.desc: Moves the selection to the clipboard and closes the gap.

items.name: Copy
items.desc: Copies the selection to the clipboard.

items.name: Paste
items.desc: Puts the clipboard at the cursor, or over the start of the selection.

items.name: Delete
items.desc: Deletes the selection and closes the gap.

items.name: Crop
items.desc: Keeps only the selection and throws the rest away.

items.name: Select all
items.desc: Selects the whole sound.

items.name: Snap to zero
items.desc: Moves the selection edges to the nearest zero crossing, so cuts do not click.

items.name: Zoom in
items.desc: Shows less of the sound, in more detail.

items.name: Zoom out
items.desc: Shows more of the sound.

items.name: Show everything
items.desc: Fits the whole sound in the display.

items.name: Zoom to selection
items.desc: Fills the display with the selection.

items.name: Repeat last operation
items.desc: Nothing to repeat yet. Apply an operation first.

items.name: Grab the last seconds
items.desc: Keeps what you already heard, even though you were not recording. Uses the pre-roll length.

items.name: Recording in stereo
items.desc: What a new take is made of. Click to switch. The display shows one lane for a mono sound and two for a stereo one. Operations like Make mono change a sound you already have.

items.name: Input: mixer channel
items.desc: Where the recording comes from. In the plugin: the mixer channel it sits on. Here: a demo loop stands in, or your microphone. Click to switch.

items.name: Monitoring the input
items.desc: Lets you hear what comes in while you record. Mute it when the sound already plays somewhere else.

items.name: Spectral view
items.desc: Shows the sound as a picture of its frequencies, with tools to cut, erase, copy and amplify parts of it.

items.name: Channels
items.desc: What the sound is made of, as detected. Click to make it mono (mix, left only or right only), swap the sides or split it into mid and side.

items.name: Sample rate
items.desc: The sample rate of this sound, as detected. Click to convert it to another rate, or to change the rate without converting.

items.name: Bit depth
items.desc: The bit depth of this sound and of the file you save. Click to change it. Going lower changes the sound, with dither if you want it.

items.name: Time line unit
items.desc: How positions and the time line are shown: time, seconds, samples, or bars and beats.

items.name: Sample tempo
items.desc: The tempo Meowcorder found in this sound. Click to set it yourself, double it, halve it, or say how many bars the sound is.

items.name: Sync
items.desc: Free plays the sound at its own speed. Sync plays it at the host tempo. Click to choose, and to pick the warp mode.

items.name: Warp settings
items.desc: Opens the warp panel: tempo sync, warp mode, transpose, fine tune and formants.

items.name: Level meters and trigger arrow
items.desc: Input (left bar) and output (right bar) level in dBFS, with peak hold. The yellow arrow is the record trigger level, the same value as the Threshold knob: drag it up or down. It starts a recording in On input mode.

items.name: Live input
items.desc: Input, always listening: the last 3 seconds. The pink band is the pre-roll that a recording would include.

items.name: Waveform
items.desc: Shows the sound as a wave. Drag to select a time range. The usual way to cut, copy and process. Click to show it alone.

items.name: Spectral view
items.desc: Shows the sound as a picture of its frequencies, with tools to cut, erase, copy and amplify parts of it. Click to show it alone.

items.name: Pitch view
items.desc: A piano roll of the notes found in the sound. Drag a note up or down to change its pitch, and the sound follows. Click to show it alone.

items.name: Show views together
items.desc: Turn on to see more than one view at once. Overlay puts them on top of each other, Split stacks them. The view In front is the one your tools work on.

items.name: Waveform pencil
items.desc: Draw the wave by hand. Zoom in until you can see single samples, then drag over the wave to set them. Shift+Q turns it on or off.

items.name: Mouse
items.desc: Click for the cursor, drag to select a time range.

items.name: Selector
items.desc: Drag a box over time and frequency. Use Cutter, Amp or Copy on the box from the Spectral menu.

items.name: Scissors
items.desc: Drag across time: that slice is cut out and the gap closes.

items.name: Cutter
items.desc: Drag a box: the sound inside it is removed, the length stays.

items.name: Eraser
items.desc: Paint over what should go. It is removed when you let go.

items.name: Copy
items.desc: Drag a box to copy that piece, then click with Paste where it should land.

items.name: Paste
items.desc: Click where the copied piece should go. Left edge is time, height is frequency.

items.name: Amp
items.desc: Drag a box: it gets the level change set next to the tools.

items.name: Pencil
items.desc: Draw a line on the picture: a pure tone follows your pen, so you can draw new sounds. Drag forward in time. The Pen level is set next to the tools. Click for a short beep.

items.name: Amp level
items.desc: Level change the Amp tool applies to the box.

items.name: Pen level
items.desc: Level of the tone the Pencil draws.

items.name: Eraser brush
items.desc: Size of the Eraser brush.

items.name: Snap notes to semitones
items.desc: Moves every note to the nearest exact semitone. Like a tuner for the whole sound, or for the selection.

items.name: Formants follow
items.desc: The voice character moves with the pitch, like speeding a tape.

items.name: Keep formants
items.desc: Keeps the voice character (the formants) while the pitch changes. Best for voices and instruments.

items.name: Drag mode
items.desc: How a dragged note lands.

items.name: Waveform display
items.desc: The sound, stereo or mono. Drag to select, click to place the cursor, Shift click to extend, wheel to zoom, Alt wheel to scroll. Operations work on the selection, or on everything when nothing is selected.

items.name: Spectral display
items.desc: Spectral view. Horizontal: time. Vertical: frequency, 20 Hz at the bottom, log scale. Colour is level. Pick a tool above it to change the sound by looking at it.

items.name: Pitch display
items.desc: Pitch view, like a piano roll: the notes found in the sound. Drag a note up or down to change its pitch.

items.name: Time line
items.desc: Time line. Click to place the cursor. The unit (time, seconds, samples, bars and beats) is set in the bar above the display.

items.name: Whole sound
items.desc: The whole sound. The lighter box is what you see above. Drag it to scroll, click to jump, wheel to zoom.

shots.view_wave: Waveform view with a selection. The yellow line over the live strip and the arrow in the meter are the record trigger.
